Then it pulls back and returns to the idle pose.
The creature starts from the idle pose of the first frame and is back in that same idle pose at the end of the video.
Game sprite animation. The creature stays in the same spot of the frame as in the first frame and keeps exactly the same design, proportions and flat cel-shaded art style as the first frame. The creature is shown at exactly the same scale as in the first frame for the whole video, and it never moves toward or away from the camera. The whole creature and everything it holds stay fully inside the frame at all times.
